scope: WEAPON towers only (Sword, Axe, Bow, Spear, Shield, Hammer): one base character per weapon emblem, four class variants of the same person within that emblem. B is the sword base. No tier-dependent character redraw.
elemental_exception: Elemental towers may be independent humanoids or beasts such as Phoenix or Lightning Wolf. Do not enforce shared identity, human facial proportions, or weapon-class hair/eye palettes on them. Share illustration style and atlas specifications.
face_lock: Use the approved master as identity and geometry source; preserve facial outline, brows, eye shapes, pupils, nose, mouth, hairline and hairstyle. Only iris and hair color follow the class palette. Costume and class accessories may change.
landmarks_note: Manual reference marks for alignment, not automatic landmark detection. The approved master pixels are authoritative.
review_gate: Align all four variants to the same master coordinates with one uniform transform.
Overlay each face at 50% opacity against the master; check both pupil centers, eye contours, jaw and chin, nose, mouth and hairline.
Correct facial drift before approval; prompt wording alone is not proof of alignment.
Compare all four in a contact sheet at the actual 512x512 cell size before atlas application.
